## DiagnosticCode type

Machine-readable diagnostic codes.

- `FIELD_PROFILE_MISMATCH`<!-- -->: Field is preserved multiple times on some paths - `UNCONSUMED_PRESERVATION`<!-- -->: Field was preserved but never consumed - `STASH_CONFLICT_POSSIBLE`<!-- -->: Multiple migrations may conflict on field preservation - `DISCONNECTED_VERSIONS`<!-- -->: Some versions cannot reach each other - `DEPRECATED_VERSION_IN_PATH`<!-- -->: Migration path uses a deprecated version - `LOSSY_PATH`<!-- -->: Migration path loses data (irreversible transformation)

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type DiagnosticCode = 'FIELD_PROFILE_MISMATCH' | 'UNCONSUMED_PRESERVATION' | 'STASH_CONFLICT_POSSIBLE' | 'DISCONNECTED_VERSIONS' | 'DEPRECATED_VERSION_IN_PATH' | 'LOSSY_PATH';
```
